crossRefs.note: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty…
Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter, the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces…
and said, “What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you?” They weighed out for him thirty pieces…
Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver…
and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

translations.web: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
translations.bsb: Or if it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
translations.kjv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
translations.asv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
